The Catalog resource describes the PostgreSQL database that holds the job, file and volume records.

## Examples

**The catalog on the local PostgreSQL server**

```text
Catalog {
  Name = MyCatalog
  DB Name = bareos
  DB User = bareos
  DB Password = "db-secret"
}
```

## Directives

| Directive | Type | Default | | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Name](#d-name) | name |  | required | Name of the catalog; Client and Pool resources and the use command refer to it. |
| [Description](#d-description) | string |  |  | Free text describing the catalog. |
| [DB Address](#d-dbaddress) | string |  |  | Host of the PostgreSQL server; without it (and without DB Socket) the local socket is used. |
| [DB Port](#d-dbport) | positive integer |  |  | TCP port of the PostgreSQL server. |
| [DB Password](#d-dbpassword) | password |  |  | Password of the database user. |
| [DB User](#d-dbuser) | string |  | required | Database user the Director connects as. |
| [DB Name](#d-dbname) | string |  | required | Name of the catalog database. |
| [DB Socket](#d-dbsocket) | string |  |  | Directory of the PostgreSQL Unix socket, instead of a TCP connection. |
| [Multiple Connections](#d-multipleconnections) | yes\|no |  | deprecated | Deprecated: use several database connections. |
| [Disable Batch Insert](#d-disablebatchinsert) | yes\|no | `no` | deprecated | Deprecated: insert file records one by one instead of in batches. |
| [Reconnect](#d-reconnect) | yes\|no | `yes` |  | Reconnect automatically when the database connection breaks. |
| [Exit On Fatal](#d-exitonfatal) | yes\|no | `no` |  | Stop the Director on a fatal database error instead of carrying on. |
| [Min Connections](#d-minconnections) | positive integer | `1` |  | Connections the connection pool opens at start. |
| [Max Connections](#d-maxconnections) | positive integer | `5` |  | Upper limit of the connection pool. |
| [Inc Connections](#d-incconnections) | positive integer | `1` |  | How many connections the pool opens at once when it grows. |
| [Idle Timeout](#d-idletimeout) | positive integer | `30` |  | Seconds after which an idle pooled connection is closed. |
| [Validate Timeout](#d-validatetimeout) | positive integer | `120` |  | Seconds after which a pooled connection is checked before use. |
| [Db Driver](#d-dbdriver) | string | `postgresql` | Onesimus | Onesimus extension: accepted so that older configurations that still name the driver load; Bareos 25 removed the directive. |

### Name {#d-name}

Key: `name` · Type: name · Required

Name of the catalog; Client and Pool resources and the use command refer to it.

```text
Catalog {
  Name = "MyCatalog"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos
```

### Description {#d-description}

Key: `description` · Type: string

Free text describing the catalog.

```text
Catalog {
  Name = MyCatalog
  Description = "Main catalog"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos description="Main catalog"
```

### DB Address {#d-dbaddress}

Key: `dbaddress` · Type: string · Aliases: Address

Host of the PostgreSQL server; without it (and without DB Socket) the local socket is used.

```text
Catalog {
  Name = MyCatalog
  DB Address = "db.example.com"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos dbaddress=db.example.com
```

### DB Port {#d-dbport}

Key: `dbport` · Type: positive integer · Aliases: Port

TCP port of the PostgreSQL server.

```text
Catalog {
  Name = MyCatalog
  DB Port = 5432
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add catalog name=MyCatalog dbuser=bareos dbname=bareos dbport=5432
```

### DB Password {#d-dbpassword}

Key: `dbpassword` · Type: password · Aliases: Password

Password of the database user. The Onesimus Director masks it (\*\*\*) in show.

  DB Password = "db-secret"
}

In the console:

```text

```

### DB Socket {#d-dbsocket}

Key: `dbsocket` · Type: string · Aliases: Socket

Directory of the PostgreSQL Unix socket, instead of a TCP connection.

```text

  Name = MyCatalog

In the console:

```

Key: `multipleconnections` · Type: yes|no · Values: `yes`, `no` · Deprecated

Key: `disablebatchinsert` · Type: yes|no · Default: `no` · Values: `yes`, `no` · Deprecated

### Db Driver {#d-dbdriver}

Key: `dbdriver` · Type: string · Default: `postgresql` · Onesimus

Onesimus extension: accepted so that older configurations that still name the driver load; Bareos 25 removed the directive. The catalog is PostgreSQL.

```text
Catalog {
  Name = MyCatalog
  Db Driver = "postgresql"
}
```
